laws.rule: Braga charges a municipal tourist tax of EUR 1.50 per guest per night (about A$2.38, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) for guests aged 16 and over, up to 4 consecutive nights (EUR 6 per stay at most).

local-law.note: Braga municipality; Guimarães has no tax in force.

layers.authority: ICNF, Parque Nacional da Peneda-Gerês (Plano de Ordenamento, RCM 11-A/2011)
layers.process: For nature-tourism activities in Peneda-Gerês National Park, the park plan sets rules by protection zone. In Total Protection areas, hiking and nature observation need authorisation and orienteering, climbing, canyoning and cycling are banned. In Partial Protection Type I and II areas, hiking needs authorisation, climbing needs authorisation, canyoning is banned in Type I and needs authorisation in Type II, mountain biking is banned in Type I and needs authorisation in Type II, and motorised all-terrain driving is banned. In Complementary Protection areas, hiking is permitted, and boat trips, canoeing, ballooning and paragliding need authorisation. Motorised aircraft activities are banned in all zones. ICNF advises contacting the park before an activity and emailing group size and date to pnpg@icnf.pt. ICNF's table says it is informative and the plan governs. The park spans Braga, Viana do Castelo and Vila Real districts; held here at Braga (Gerês side).
